subject: Publisher access & co-publish terms for Evelyn Models weights
messages:
From: Tom Harris <tharris@evelynmodels.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Distribution & access for EV weights (intro)

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for taking this. Evelyn Models is evaluating a distribution path for two large-release model families (EV-Large-v1 and EV-Chat-v1). We want to make weights available through a controlled partner channel (not fully public GitHub) and are exploring three things: 1) a pragmatic weights-access policy, 2) escrow or gated distribution options, and 3) co-publishing / attribution language.

Attached is a short intro + scope doc that summarizes what we can and can't publish today (evelyn-intro-and-scope.pdf). High level asks from our side:
- We need per-release trust controls (who can download weights) and an audit trail.
- We prefer a rev-share on downstream commercial use, but are flexible on structure.
- We are open to a limited-time exclusivity window for some partners if that aligns with revenue guarantees.

Can your team share typical access terms you offer to model publishers, and whether Redwood supports escrowed storage / time-limited tokenized downloads? Also would like an early sketch of a mutual action plan we can review with legal.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call.

Tom Harris
Head of Partnerships, Evelyn Models
partners@evelynmodels.com
+1 415 555 0112

Attachment: evelyn-intro-and-scope.pdf (1 page summary)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Harris <tharris@evelynmodels.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Distribution & access for EV weights (intro)

Tom —

Great to meet you over email. High level: Redwood supports a range of publisher models from fully public model listings to gated distribution (tokenized downloads + per-customer agreements). We also offer storage-for-escrow workflows where we hold a signed copy of weights and mediate distribution per the publisher's policy.

I've attached our onboarding checklist and a first-draft "weights access" term sheet (proposed-weights-access-terms_v1.docx) to give you a concrete starting point. Key points to note from our side:
- Access controls: role-based access + download tokens with TTL; audit logs preserved for 7 years by default (configurable for enterprise).
- Commercials: typical baseline is 20-30% rev-share for publisher revenue on hosted endpoints; for dedicated / private deployments we negotiate a flat hosting fee.
- Escrow: we can act as a technical escrow (store artifact + release per triggers) and can integrate with LegalOps-style escrow agreements.
- Exclusivity: we can support time-limited exclusivity windows (30/60/90 days) but will need minimum guarantees or an upsell commitment for Dedicated placement.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick call to align scope & exclusivity ask (30m).
2) We circulate MAP + commercial options.
3) Legal redlines and Exec approval.

Are you available tomorrow 4/21 for a brief sync?

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Partner Alliances, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-publisher-onboarding-checklist.pdf, proposed-weights-access-terms_v1.docx

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Distribution & access for EV weights — internal (planning)

Internal —

Forwarding Tom's note from Evelyn Models. Short ask: they want a gated distribution option + potential exclusivity for certain launch partners. I attached our checklist/term sheet.

What I think we need from each:
- Camila: commercial stance + partner packaging options (rev-share vs. hosting fee, exclusivity tiers).
- Sergio: high-level IP/redistribution guardrails — can we support a split license (hosted endpoint rights vs. weight redistribution restrictions)?
- Marissa: product implications (artifact size, storage, quantization support, tokenized downloads).
- Kimberly: if they prefer escrow, what legal template and audit requirements do we require?

Ideal timeline: send a MAP to Evelyn by EOD 4/21 so they can review with their counsel.

Thanks — Naomi

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Distribution & access for EV weights — internal (planning)

All —

Quick thoughts after scanning the intro:
- Commercials: propose two go-to-market packages: 1) "Marketplace" (non-exclusive, 25% rev-share on hosted usage; standard onboarding fee $10k) and 2) "Premier Co-publish" (exclusive window up to 60 days with 40% rev-share + $50k launch guarantee or Dedicated minimum commitment).
- Escrow: recommend technical escrow as a default; for legal escrow we involve LegalOps and require a signed escrow agreement that defines release triggers and audit cadence.
- Attribution: require a visible attribution banner on hosted endpoints and a mandatory press coordination window for any public statements.
- Redistribution rights: we should carve a two-tier license: hosted inference allowed (with rev-share) but redistribution of raw weights requires a separate license and co-sign from publisher (and will default to "not permitted" unless negotiated).

Product notes for Marissa: the artifacts are large; we should offer quantized delta packages (4-bit/8-bit) for gated downloads to reduce bandwidth and enable faster on-prem installs. We'll need to confirm replication costs for escrow storage.

I'll draft a one-page MAP and hand to Naomi to send to Evelyn.

— Camila

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Harris <tharris@evelynmodels.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MAP & next steps (Evelyn Models)

Tom —

Thanks again for the overview. Per internal alignment we've put together a short mutual action plan and two commercial options for you to review. See summary below and attached full MAP + term sheet. Attachments: redwood-publisher-onboarding-checklist.pdf, proposed-weights-access-terms_v1.docx.

Summary MAP (proposed)
- Week 0: NDA (if needed) + scope confirmation.
- Week 1: Security checklist + host environment assessment.
- Week 2: Legal redlines exchanged (we'll track via DocuSign/HubSpot).
- Week 3: Technical onboarding — upload to escrow + verification.
- Week 4: Soft launch to selected partners / marketplace listing.

Commercial options (high level)
- Marketplace (non-exclusive): 25% rev-share on hosted usage; $10k onboarding fee; standard audit log retention (7 years).
- Premier Co-publish (limited exclusivity): 40% rev-share, $50k launch guarantee or equivalent Dedicated commitment, exclusivity up to 60 days.

Escrow approach: we offer two models — 1) Technical escrow (we store artifacts encrypted, release per publisher-specified tokens and log every download) and 2) Legal escrow (we coordinate with LegalOps and escrow agent; additional fees apply).

Next: if you're comfortable, I can post the MAP to HubSpot and send a DocuSign bundle with the term sheet for initial redlines. Also proposing a 30-minute call Friday 4/23 at 10:00 PT to walk through technical questions.

Link to MAP & DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/embedded/abc123

Best,
Naomi
Head of Partner Alliances
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-publisher-onboarding-checklist.pdf, proposed-weights-access-terms_v1.docx

From: Tom Harris <tharris@evelynmodels.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Models Partnerships <partners@evelynmodels.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP & next steps (Evelyn Models)

Naomi —

Appreciate the clear MAP and the commercial options. A couple of follow-ups from our end before committing:
1) Quantization & fidelity: if we provide a 4-bit quantized derivative for gated downloads, can Redwood guarantee a provenance chain so downstream users can verify they are using the published quantized artifact vs. a fork? We want integrity checks baked into the download flow.
2) Exclusivity: the 60-day window is interesting; would you be open to a 45-day term with an automatic extension if launch minimums are met?
3) Escrow legalities: we'll have LegalOps send a proposed escrow schedule — expect a few redlines on release triggers (esp. in M&A scenarios).

We can do the Friday 4/23 10:00 PT call. Please send an invite and agenda. Also please include the product engineer who owns artifact ingestion so we can confirm the quantization/manifest workflow.

Tom
Head of Partnerships, Evelyn Models
